rules:
Welcome to the GTA Speedrunners' Server! This server is sponsored by Joshimuz and run by 123robot with assistance from Parik, LotsOfS, & SpeedyFolf.
FOR HELP PRESS F9 to bring up the help menu. This can answer many of your questions. The framerate is set to 30 so that physics are near identical to those in Joshimuz's speedruns. THE FRAMERATE WILL NOT BE CHANGED.
If you have a map you want added, consult the readme on the public GitLab (https://gitlab.com/The123robot/robot-mta-server) for instructions and guidelines.
If you're able to, donations to help support the server would be much appreciated through the following link: https://streamlabs.com/123robot/tip
SERVER RULES:
You made us spell out the rules, so here:
1) Zero Tolerance towards bigotry.
You should really know what we mean by this. It is the same rule as it exists in literally every other place. We do not care for your silly arguments on why "it is okay in this case", your shit hurts thousands of people who have indicated repeatedly that this shit hurts them. This shouldn't be a new concept to you.
This includes racism (racial discrimination), sexism, homophobia, transphobia, xenophobia, or any other form of bigotry. I am sure you can think of some clever thing that does not fall within these categories. Good for you, you are now clever bigot. You will be dealt with in the same as all the other ones.
2) Don't spam the chat.
Communication is half the fun of multiplayer games. Chat is here so people can talk, banter, and share reactions to the fun moments that happen in-game. But if you start flooding it with trash, spam, or other stuff that makes it unreadable, it just becomes annoying.
This server operates in English. Other languages are allowed, but keep in mind our moderators, and many other people, might not understand what you're saying. Excessive talking in other languages might quickly turn into spam as perceived by everybody else, so keep that in mind.
If we think you are breaking any of the other rules but you do it in a different language to be sneaky sneaky, then we will deal with it first and consult a translator second.
3) No stream sniping.
Hey, this server is run by and for livestreamers. That means you can stream snipe, but it does not mean that you should stream snipe. You'll be perceived as a lousy player and your presence will not be enjoyed. You will be banned in the server, on stream, and maybe even on Twitch. Woah!
4) No cheating, ugh.
Hey this is obvious. But I guess I'll spell it out because some dumbass will go "RHRURURHRU it doesn't say it in the rules RHRHR". Well guess what fancy pants: Now it does! Not that it makes a difference, if you do something stupid that isn't in these rules we may decide to do something about it anyway. Yes, we can do that! Take it up with your local representative if you don't like it.
This includes scripts, hacks, etc. Also: The official MTA team is very zealous, overly so, in catching cheaters. They will probably catch you before we do, and then the fun is really getting started for you. But if you do manage to slip through the cracks, please know that you are ruining everybody's fun, and that this might be one of the reasons that no one likes you. Some self-reflection might be in order. Did you know that there are people to help with that too? Consult your local doctor.
5) Griefing is a gray area.
Some maps encourage a little chaos, where griefing might be part of the fun. We understand that, so we will not crack down on every silly moment or tomfoolery that you might get up to.
But, newsflash: There is a difference between some fun chaos, and just being a knob. If people are laughing with you, awesomesauce! But if they're visibly annoyed, then your griefing has turned from being goofy into being toxic. Read the room.
Here's a rule of thumb. If you are having fun, but nobody else is, then you are not the comedic genius you think you are. You are just a jerk who likes to have fun at the expense of others. It may be just a game, but make sure it is a fun game for everyone.
Furthermore, the game isn't a battleground to settle your silly extraludic personal grudges. Someone slipped up and threw an f-bomb your way a year ago? Oopsie. You were justified in executing a targeted attack and ramming them off the road 5 minutes later. But shit like this shouldn't carry over past a good night's sleep, or even a less good night's sleep, or even like 2 races later. Just play the game, and if you have a problem with someone take it elsewhere.
6) Just be a decent person, really.
Don't make it so we have to deal with you. It should be easy. If it isn't, maybe have a thinkover about why it isn't easy for you.
It is highly possible we forgot to spell out a rule here. Don't make us spell out yet another rule. Enjoy the game, and have others enjoy the game.
We will deal with infractions however we see fit. This may vary case by case depending on our mood at the time. Maybe you'll just get muted in chat, or maybe you'll get banned. This latter could be for a day, or permanently. Maybe you'll get banned temporarily, but no one can be bothered to unban you or they would forget. That wouldn't be so good for you if you want to play, would it?
But it should not be the punishment that is deterring you from breaking these rules, it should be the desire to be a good person.
